current_row.title: FP2: Equipping Robotic Foundation Models with Force Control
current_row.org: FORTE Lab; Noematrix; Flexiv; SJTU et al.
current_row.one_line: Action-regulation split: a task-adapted robot foundation model generates actions while a plug-in force-control policy predicts force-control parameters from its context plus wrench history. Real arm, four backbones, four contact-rich tasks: every backbone's average score improves, by up to 65 points.

current_row.title: Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video
current_row.one_line: TRACC imitates the usable motion prefix of a failed human video, then trains with a VLM-proposed task-completion reward to reach the intended goal; evaluated in simulation (Unitree G1, Isaac Gym) on six Oops! failures.

current_row.title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
current_row.short: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
current_row.one_line: PRISM expands a few human videos into hundreds of counterfactual interactions, reconstructs physically plausible simulation trajectories, and trains depth-based humanoid policies for joystick-controlled picking, carrying and dropping, transferred zero-shot to real hardware.

current_row.title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
current_row.one_line: Coding agent reads demo evidence packs (keyframes, gripper events, trajectories), refines a policy program without seeing the success signal, then freezes it; LIBERO-PRO 96.3% (3 demos) vs 89.3% for ASPIRE rerun with the same LLM; real bimanual tasks.

current_row.title: T²Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
current_row.one_line: Test-time training compresses observation history into fast weights inside a pretrained VLA; RoboMME 16-task success rises from 17.93% to 56.83%, with 3x+ faster inference than explicit memory.

current_row.title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
current_row.one_line: LucidWM applies Subjective Logic to categorical latent transitions, giving each a doubt degree and multiplying trust along imagined rollouts without extra parameters; trust-based action selection cuts navigation steps-to-goal from 362 to 190.

current_row.title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
current_row.one_line: Closed-loop RL post-training of E2E driving policies inside video world models, keeping only rollouts an inverse-dynamics evaluator deems action-faithful; cuts safety violations 27.6% (DiffusionDrive, nuScenes).

current_row.title: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness
current_row.short: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data
current_row.one_line: Theory of RE(S), REINFORCE with rollouts refreshed every S steps, in softmax bandits: global convergence, Θ(1/T) rate, and moderate off-policyness escaping weak-initialization traps faster.

current_row.title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
current_row.one_line: RoboSkill: multimodal agent loop that explores, executes with vision/tactile feedback, and evolves a reusable code-skill library; LIBERO-10 first-episode success +12.5-25.0 points, real robot +8.3 points.

current_row.title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
current_row.one_line: Agentic Real2Sim2Real: reconstructs simulation gyms from videos; an agent writes stage-level manipulation code and distills successes and failures into reusable skills without weight updates; zero-shot real Franka 9/12 trials vs 5/12 for GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode.

current_row.title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
current_row.one_line: ContextProgress-Bench (24 manipulation tasks, 120 episodes) shows progress reward models get lost even with full history; given the right context their error drops 77-82%, and an agentic VLM loop supplying it cuts a frozen PRM's error 63%.

current_row.title: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
current_row.short: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
current_row.one_line: Signed credit from action-induced observation changes trains an action reranker around a frozen navigation policy at test time; a separate memory verifies candidate reranker updates and rolls back unsupported changes.

current_row.title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
current_row.one_line: Stabilizes PPO's critic for LLM RL via actor-only truncation filtering, noise-normalized critic regression and smaller critic minibatches; relative gains of 14.89% coding, 2.28% math, 9.47% search over PPO.

current_row.title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Dual-loop harness evolves task- and action-level knowledge from rollouts with the VLM agent frozen; up to +24.2 points on RMBench; held-out success 70.0% to 88.3% (GPT-6) and 48.3% to 75.0% (GPT-5.5) after 80 rollouts.

current_row.title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
current_row.one_line: Learns rewards by regressing task progress from tactile deformation maps of successful and failed demos; lifts nut threading 34% to 56% (sim) and real cube pickup 37% to 97%.

current_row.title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: A VLM turns observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic specs, with thresholds grounded from successful robot trajectories, as dense and progress rewards for PPO; four ManiSkill3 sim tasks: 85.8%/67.0% success-once/at-end vs 81.5%/59.5% native dense reward.

current_row.title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
current_row.one_line: Policy runs autonomously; a VLM monitors in parallel and intervenes only on detected errors. With GPT: Cosmos Policy +5.6 and pi0.5 +7.5 pts on RoboCasa; pi0.5 47.2% to 57.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 Hard, 53% to 83% real robot.

current_row.title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
current_row.one_line: Open-weights dual-arm VLA family (YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, FR3 Duo) with embodiment-specific midtraining; a latent policy adapts online from as few as 15 corrected episodes.

current_row.title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Action-driven visual simulator learned from 10,000+ h action-free robot video and grounded with 2,000+ h action trajectories; 74% trajectory-success prediction accuracy (strongest baseline 73%); best-of-32 selection with its rollouts beats direct execution by 19.1-21.4 points on RoboTwin, zero-shot.

current_row.title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
current_row.short: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors
current_row.one_line: Deployment-time adaptation updates a VLA online from the commanded-vs-executed motion residual, without rewards or labels; adds RoboStress sim benchmark (friction, backlash, compliance, gravity-comp error); >30-point real success gains on two Piper arms (one new, one used a year).

current_row.title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
current_row.one_line: World action model adapts to unseen tasks from its own generated video-action rollouts (never executed), training on VLM-selected task-completing prefixes verified by inverse dynamics; Cosmos3 on seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks 26.9% to 68.0%, three real tasks 20.0% to 76.7%.

current_row.title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
current_row.one_line: DEWO: post-deployment world-action-model learning from successful and failed futures for classifier-free guidance, activated by a progress value head when progress stalls; four real dexterous tasks: two rounds lift success 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success.

current_row.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
current_row.short: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
current_row.one_line: Three-stage RL fine-tuning for multi-robot VLAs: initialization-aware data collection, credit-filtered offline tuning, online latent-noise RL (DSRL) on the frozen VLA. Average success over the CHORUS SFT baseline: +23.1% RoboTwin, +16.4% RoboFactory, +44% on real dual-Franka tasks.

current_row.title: ReF-HIL: Shaping the Critic around Human Action Neighborhoods for Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Guides the online critic with an IQL value reference learned from successful human data, plus a learned human-action 'fence': no imitation penalty inside it, constrained updates outside. Real plug insertion: 91.7% vs 5% or less for HG-DAgger, HIL-SERL and SiLRI.

current_row.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
current_row.one_line: Agentic pipeline with property-specific verifiers and a self-evolving tool library turns a single egocentric human video into sim-generated robot trajectories for training pi0.5; 63.6% average success over 11 real dexterous tasks, about 3.5x SPIDER's.

current_row.title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
current_row.one_line: Training-free harness for lifelong navigation that carries maps, task records and house knowledge across sessions, checking them against new observations; on GOAT-Bench with GPT-6 Astra, +18.6 s-SR points over context-only independent sessions and a reported state-of-the-art 83.7 s-SR (SLAM poses).

current_row.title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
current_row.one_line: Shows policy-gradient stabilization succeeds with zeroth-order (configuration) reward terms alone; adding velocity reward terms can introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows, while velocity remains necessary in the policy observation (low-dissipation assumption).

current_row.title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
current_row.org: Cambridge / MIT / Basis / Cornell / Princeton et al.
current_row.one_line: Agent runs experiments to learn residual world models (physics engine plus code for missing forces/constraints/hidden state) with Bayesian inference; solves more tasks with fewer interactions than baselines.

current_row.title: QAMM: Adjoint MeanFlow Matching for Few-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Turns the critic's adjoint-matching signal into supervision for MeanFlow average velocity, yielding two-call flow policies competitive with flow-policy baselines on ten HumanoidMaze offline RL tasks.

current_row.title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
current_row.one_line: Training-free: keeps executing the normally discarded tail of each action chunk until action velocity starts to fluctuate; 1.2-1.7x fewer policy calls with no loss in success rate across three VLAs and one World Action Model, in sim and real.

current_row.title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
current_row.one_line: Training-free NUDGE injects signed-distance-field gradients, via a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder, into the denoising loop of diffusion/flow policies and VLAs to steer action chunks around obstacles; real UR5 with a moving obstacle: 75.6% contact-free completion (62/82) vs 16.7% (3/18) unguided pi0.

current_row.title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
current_row.short: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
current_row.one_line: OLIVE: DAgger-like online LLM distillation; student generates prefix, teacher continues it, student trains by cross-entropy. +13% over offline SFT on ScienceWorld; async cuts training time 23.8%.

current_row.title: Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity
current_row.short: Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity
current_row.one_line: BFM-QD runs quality-diversity search in a behavioral foundation model's compact latent space, giving a gradient-free, critic-free improvement operator that beats parameter-space QD on sparse/deceptive continuous control (NeurIPS 2026).

current_row.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
current_row.short: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
current_row.one_line: TeAR: a lightweight Transformer rectifies a frozen policy's actions from live actuator telemetry (temperature, current, voltage); on a real SO-101 arm under heating, Lift success 85% vs 75% and 70% for the frozen base (20 trials each), no on-robot fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
current_row.one_line: SCOUT meta-learns a belief latent shared by policy and forward dynamics model; at test time it updates the belief from dynamics prediction error, enabling fast adaptation and sim-to-real transfer (CoRL 2026).

current_row.title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
current_row.short: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
current_row.one_line: PPO with a chunked actor and a standard state-value critic; ACPPO-Corr adds a stepwise feedback corrector inside each chunk. 25 IsaacGym/Bi-DexHands tasks: best aggregate IQM, +30.4% over PPO; per task vs best baseline, 13 wins, 8 ties, 4 losses.

current_row.title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
current_row.one_line: Simulator-state failure diagnosis retrieves corrections from a human trajectory bank; correction SFT precedes safety-reward GRPO. Driving VLA: NAVSIM v1 PDMS 87.7→91.7; the same checkpoint scores 89.4 EPDMS on original NAVTEST scenes under v2 metrics.

current_row.title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: Latent world model pretrained on successful and failed trajectories, then contrastively tuned on matched success-failure pairs, gives a differentiable reward for VLA training and is dropped at deployment; LIBERO average 98.4% vs 97.1% for OpenVLA-OFT; SimplerEnv Google Robot 72.0%.

current_row.title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
current_row.one_line: On-policy distillation of task-specific teachers into a pretrained world action model via prefix-weighted trajectory replay over a fixed rollout pool, improving target tasks without extra environment interaction.

current_row.title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
current_row.one_line: Turns group-standardized rewards into a target distribution and matches it by forward KL over trajectory log-probs instead of maximizing reward; for VLAs, on average +8.0/+4.8 points over the best reward-maximizing baselines on simulated task/scene OOD (MetaWorld/CALVIN).

current_row.title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
current_row.one_line: Prerequisite-gated, paced rewards from simulator-verified subtask predicates (not a learned model); RoboCasa365 GR00T-N1.5 49.1% vs 41.5% for the best terminal-reward baseline, and it beats Robometer on LIBERO-Long (96.6 vs 94.2).

current_row.title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies (AGF)
current_row.one_line: Lightweight guidance net regressed onto the adjoint costate replaces per-step critic backprop for a frozen flow VLA; 3.6x faster per step than QGF. Real YAM arm, pooled (n=75): base 66.7%, QGF 68.0%, AGF 84.0%.

current_row.title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Offline, supervised hidden-space residual expert bank with a Null route, trained on logged failures of a frozen pi0.5. RoboTwin average 49.50 → 60.50, vs PPO 55.75.

current_row.title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: An agentic VLM builds verified event timelines as offline progress labels; LIBERO-Long 57.9 vs 44.2 vanilla BC; exposes reward models that credit the wrong object.

current_row.title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
current_row.short: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
current_row.one_line: PolicyWeave: shared-action-interface LoRA post-training plus context-guided sparse merging of VLA task experts; 18 RoboCasa365 tasks: 74.1% merging RL experts vs 60.7% joint RL.

current_row.title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
current_row.one_line: DPP: training-free; the WAM's rollout estimates interaction timing, tracked target motion gives the future position, and a counterfactual observation lets the WAM reuse static skills; real robot, grasping a moving object: 76.7% vs 0% for reactive replanning (30 trials).

current_row.title: Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: RECON: model-based IL splitting a conservative main policy from an explorer that seeks epistemically uncertain yet recoverable states (via multi-step imagination); improves interaction efficiency on locomotion, navigation, manipulation.

current_row.title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Uses glove tactile signals as RL guidance to steer policy search toward human contact patterns when retargeting mocap to robot hands; learns marker/hammer use, beats distance-based rewards.

current_row.title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
current_row.org: USTC; CAS Institute of AI for Industries; Shenzhen University
current_row.one_line: Compensatory force fields from human demos plus robot contact state condition a PPO residual policy correcting retargeted dexterous-hand motions on articulated objects. Vs DexMachina over four simulated hands, overall completion ratio 0.606 → 0.772; real runs are open-loop replays.

current_row.title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
current_row.one_line: Recurrent residual PPO policy over a classical anti-swing prior, plus an age-aware world model for delayed or lost sensing, for robot-arm cable-suspended payload insertion onto rebar pins. Hardest sim setting: 69.5% strict success; physical rig: 18/20 with no real fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Off-policy actor-critic diffusion policy with a two-branch score target gated by an HJ reachability critic: Q-score matching when feasible, recovery denoising otherwise; tested on quadrotor, fixed-wing, Safety-Gymnasium.

current_row.title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
current_row.one_line: Training-free Feynman-Kac particle reweighting steers a frozen grasp diffusion model with deployment-specific rewards, shifting samples from infeasible to feasible grasp modes for single- and dual-arm setups.

current_row.title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
current_row.one_line: PARS perturbs proprioceptive state and anchors only the later predicted trajectory to the demo, teaching recovery without extra interaction or expert queries; improves robustness on 51 RLBench tasks.

current_row.title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
current_row.one_line: Evolution strategies search a contrastively learned genome of freeform manipulator bodies, with RL training each design; printed prototypes run zero-shot, and the real didactyl rotator turns unseen objects at 1.39 rad/s vs 0.74 for Fay et al.'s best design.

current_row.title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
current_row.short: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
current_row.one_line: Simify reconstructs sim-ready 3D assets from RGB-D and optimizes object placements in massively parallel physics simulation at test time for unseen-object rearrangement; IROS 2026.

current_row.title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
current_row.one_line: Single-view image-to-3D meshes feed massively parallel sim RL with a contact-state-sampling action space; no demos or pretraining, 87% real-world success after ~119 s training.

current_row.title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
current_row.one_line: Builds 3D Gaussian-splat + SAM3D scenes from RGB-D for simulation-before-execution, filtering infeasible action sequences; validated on rigid, soft and deformable object manipulation.

current_row.title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
current_row.short: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: A strong agent distills its VLA-intervention experience into a playbook for a light agent, refined recursively from the light agent's execution feedback; real world (3 tasks): 64.0% vs 37.3% for pi0.5 alone; SimplerEnv Bridge: 66.7% vs 41.7% GR00T-only.

current_row.title: Schrödinger–Föllmer Actor–Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis
current_row.one_line: SFAC: offline-to-online diffusion policy improvement via Doob h-transform drift correction estimated with paired self-normalized importance sampling and a minimax Bellman critic; finite-sample bounds, six continuous-control tasks.

current_row.title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
current_row.one_line: Training-free neuro-symbolic layer wrapping frozen VLAs: a phase FSM applies rule-based corrections and an inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term adds dynamics; on 10 LIBERO-Spatial sim tasks, up to +6 pts success and +19.3 pts stability; <1 ms overhead.

current_row.title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
current_row.one_line: Frozen action-conditioned world model scores whether a WAM's actions match its visual plan and goal; Flow Policy Optimization tunes the action head without online robot interaction or task-specific reward models; four real UR5 tasks: 43.4% to 75.1% mean (pi0.5: 61.4%).

current_row.title: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Replay-free continual VLA fine-tuning as constrained optimization: method-of-multipliers dual penalty plus selective anchoring of parameters critical to earlier tasks; after three sequential LIBERO tasks, replay-free baselines score 0% on the first task, SAMBAR 84%.

current_row.title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
current_row.one_line: Flow-matching VLA carries a shared fast-weight policy state, updated at deployment from its own action-generation features without expert labels; +10.68 pts mean success over a matched policy without test-time training on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean; also tested on 12 real-robot tasks.

current_row.title: Timestep Weighting: A Hidden Key to Effective ELBO-Based Flow-Matching RL
current_row.one_line: Studies timestep weighting in ELBO-based flow-matching RL (CIFAR fine-tuning, from-scratch simulated robot control): the best weighting is task- and stage-dependent, motivating a policy-reward-gap hypothesis; dynamic schedules beat the best tested fixed weighting, by small margins on some robot tasks.

current_row.title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
current_row.one_line: Coordination head predicts a residual denoiser over frozen single-agent diffusion policies, trained on few collaborative demos plus self-distilled data. Sim: higher coordination success than baselines; real two-xArm7 task: ties full fine-tuning on coordination while retaining single-arm skills better.

current_row.title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: NeurIPS 2026 position paper: offline RL should produce adaptive policy priors that keep improving online via memory, exploration and self-correction (AORL); Bayesian offline RL as one route.

current_row.title: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing |Q| Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic
current_row.short: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing |Q| Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value…
current_row.one_line: In high-UTD SAC, rank collapse is survivable, but how far log|Q| has climbed by step 15k ranks runs by how soon the training guard flags them (out-of-sample AUC 0.78 Walker2d, 0.98 Ant, at UTD 4), enabling early aborts.

current_row.title: Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View
current_row.one_line: RAFALE: off-policy safe-RL actor-critic that differentiates an augmented objective through a flow policy's generation process, framed as a constrained Schrödinger bridge; cost within budget on seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks.

current_row.title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: Online fine-tunes flow-matching-pretrained cooperative multi-agent policies via explicit action likelihoods and shared team advantages; average relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest offline baselines (30 settings) and 29.8% over purely online learning (38 matched-budget comparisons).

current_row.title: Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization
current_row.one_line: ARBO: an LLM agent builds its reward-search strategy at run time from a persistent evaluation history; with 128 reward samples, ten simulated Bi-DexHands tasks average 0.918 success vs 0.792 for the best baseline (Eureka).

current_row.title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
current_row.one_line: Teacher gives local corrections on the student's own failure histories; only environment-verified corrections become on-policy distillation supervision (RE-OPD), with a per-round gain lower bound.

current_row.title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
current_row.one_line: Treats the embodied agent's supporting system (context/memory management, hierarchical skills) as a policy evolved from execution traces; lifts GPT-5.5 on EmbodiedBench from 56.9% to 72.7% (27.8% relative) and beats CaP-Agent0 under all LIBERO-PRO perturbations.

current_row.title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
current_row.one_line: Splits long-horizon tasks into atomic skills, picks the most-failing ones, restores simulator states captured just before them, and RL-updates shared per-family LoRA adapters with LLM-written success checks. LIBERO average (GR00T N1.5) 53.1% → 65.4% after three rounds, no extra demos.

current_row.title: Causeway: Restoring Task Accessibility for Instruction Switching in VLA Policies
current_row.one_line: Training-free inference-time steering: backpropagates through frozen VLA decoding to apply state-directed action-stream edits that recover from 'task islands'; instruction-switch success rises from 3-26% to 47-65% on LIBERO-Goal, plus xArm validation.

current_row.title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
current_row.one_line: A multi-agent world-action model predicts team return for candidate joint actions so a frozen multi-agent flow policy can rank them at test time; +22.0% mean relative gain over direct execution across 30 offline MARL settings; scoring takes 12.1 ms (A100).

current_row.title: G2MAF: Test-Time Gradient Guidance for Multi-Agent Flow Policies
current_row.one_line: Refines frozen offline multi-agent flow-policy actions at test time with one globally normalized, projected critic gradient; improves 20 of 24 MPE/SMAC settings, with mean relative gains of 9.2% (MPE) and 8.9% (SMAC) at ~6% extra inference latency.

current_row.title: Learning to Leverage Compliance: A Policy-Admittance Learning Framework for Robotic Insertion
current_row.one_line: LeCo: multirate contact feedback becomes conflict and high-force reward costs so the policy cooperates with a fixed admittance controller; 94% aggregate success on four real connector tasks, ~30% lower successful-trial force peaks than the comparison baseline.

current_row.title: Multi-Objective Human-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization of a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton
current_row.short: Multi-Objective Human-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization of a Lower-Limb Exoskeleton
current_row.one_line: MO-HILBO: multi-objective human-in-the-loop Bayesian optimization inferring personalized Pareto-optimal exoskeleton controllers over metabolic cost and comfort; Pareto orderings consistent with validation trials; open-source mohilo package.

current_row.title: Generate, Track, Improve: Perceptive Multi-Skill Humanoid Locomotion with RL-Fine-Tuned Motion Generators
current_row.one_line: Off-policy RL (structured search plus advantage-weighted regression) fine-tunes a depth-conditioned flow-matching motion generator feeding a tracking policy; in simulation vs the pre-fine-tuned generator, up to +25 points terrain traversal and +80 skill selection; G1 hardware shown qualitatively.

current_row.title: Precision at Speed: Sample-Efficient Online Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Hydraulic Excavator Control
current_row.one_line: Online MBRL with a probabilistic dynamics ensemble and sampling-based MPC learned from scratch on an 11.5-ton excavator; sub-centimeter mean path error after 40 minutes of real interaction.

current_row.title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
current_row.one_line: Learned interactive world simulator that predicts joint torques and renders haptic feedback to teleoperators; 1.6x data-collection throughput, policies from generated demos reach 54/60 real vs 19/60 vision-only.

current_row.title: Learning Robot Policies from Sparse Success Signals via STL-Guided Stein Variational Policy Gradient
current_row.one_line: STL-SVPG: population-based Stein variational policy gradient using smooth STL robustness as a trajectory-level objective; best success on 5 of 6 quadcopter/manipulator benchmarks, with sim-to-real transfer.

current_row.title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
current_row.one_line: Concept paper (no experiments yet) proposing a JEPA-style world model trained in a VLA's vision-encoder embedding space, to test whether those embeddings predict action outcomes and to plan short horizons by sampling VLA actions toward goal images.

current_row.title: RoboMonitor: Label-Efficient Runtime Monitoring of Robot Task Execution via Predictive Representation Learning
current_row.one_line: Runtime execution monitor pretrained with action-conditioned future-feature prediction, inverse dynamics and masked prediction; 93.1% phase accuracy from 52 labeled episodes, 35/40 real trials with zero false recoveries.

current_row.title: PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: IRL framework calibrating learned rewards with task-progress annotations; higher return and task success with only 20% of demonstrations annotated, and robust to reward hacking.

current_row.title: Kintsugi-VLA: Turning Failed Robot Rollouts into Recovery Data through Interventional Recoverability
current_row.one_line: Restores simulator states along failed rollouts to estimate recoverability and generate targeted recovery data; SmolVLA recovery success 34.6-38.4%, 5.8-6.7 points over uniform sampling.

current_row.title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL
current_row.one_line: Sim-trained TD3 residual that reads the VLA's own latent, aligned sim-to-real with an OT mapper. Real Flower: button 67.5% → 100%, block push 22.5% → 50%.

current_row.title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models (FIND)
current_row.org: TU Darmstadt; Hessian.AI; U Augsburg; Tongji University; Shanghai Research Institute for Intelligent Autonomous Systems
current_row.one_line: Real RL without per-episode scene resets: a VLM picks feasible, weakest tasks and judges success for a critic-gated residual on a frozen pi0.5. 8-task human-assessed success 55% → 71.9%; a 456-episode run needed 30 scene-recovery interventions.

current_row.title: Training-free Behavior Cloning
current_row.one_line: Behavior Predictive Control: action-aware retrieval over a demo bank, a Hankel-based action-continuation prior and a closed-form residual correction replace policy training; competitive with pi0.5 (better in some cases), fits in seconds, runs 75+ Hz on Jetson Orin Nano.

current_row.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
current_row.one_line: VLM agent harness with contact views, imagined action rehearsal and in-view correction plus demo-derived skills; 75.6% on LIBERO-Pro; its traces lift a small model's OOD success from 1.7% to 43.3%.

current_row.title: Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think
current_row.one_line: Anchored Planning: training-free fix for frozen latent world-model planners that retrieves offline trajectory segments and plans toward intermediate anchor observations, beating final-goal search on long-range goals across four tasks.

current_row.title: RACaP: Agentic Reasoning, Acting, and Coding as Policies for Evolvable Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Two-phase offline evolution (capability curriculum, then self-evolution) improves typed Policy APIs, a ReAct harness and long-term experience memory; at deployment ReAct calls the frozen APIs; 46.0% on LIBERO-Long vs at most 4.0% for Code-as-Policies baselines.

current_row.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
current_row.one_line: Evolves a program-level harness across rollouts from execution feedback without retraining the wrapped action model; LIBERO-PRO 96.5% vs 34.9% for pi0.5 alone (+61.6 points); fine-tuning pi0.5 on harness-collected rollouts lifts it to 73.7%.

current_row.title: AdaHVLA: Adaptive Harnesses for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Execution
current_row.one_line: Multi-agent loop (analyze, revise, assess) refines the code harness around frozen VLAs from rollout experience via a stateful revision graph; in simulation, NaVILA-LH test success 22.5% to 31.7-57.5% across six adaptation LLMs, manipulation up to +30.8 points.

current_row.title: Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling
current_row.short: Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling
current_row.one_line: OSRAM: meta-trains a closed-loop dynamics model in randomized sim, fine-tunes on limited real data, then optimizes reference commands online for a frozen controller; reduces bipedal tracking error on hardware.

current_row.title: Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search for Robotic Control
current_row.short: Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search for Robotic Control
current_row.one_line: LLM-as-optimizer policy search that sends only encoded policy parameters and scaled rewards to cloud LLMs; beats the baseline prompted search on 7 of 10 control tasks.

current_row.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
current_row.one_line: Joint-embedding latent world model with residual dynamics plus action-recovery regularization (heads dropped at test time) keeps candidate actions distinguishable for MPC; OGBench-Cube hard-start success 52.0% vs 3.7% for a matched LeWM baseline; zero-shot Franka pick-and-place 42.2% to 71.1%.

current_row.title: Policy-Calibrated DAgger: Offline Calibrated Noise Injection for Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Calibrates DAgger-style noise injection offline from a diffusion policy's own action spread along expert trajectories; beats un-noised DAgger and matches hindsight-optimal noise without sweeps.

current_row.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
current_row.one_line: Post-trains a VLA with a plug-in context encoder that turns its own failed rollouts into an AdaLN context token; summing tokens across retries lifts average success under actuation bias from 7.5% to 72.5% within 6 trials (nominal 88.8%), four tasks.

current_row.title: Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: IQL chunk critic with future latent supervision conditions a diffusion actor on high-value chunks, then selects best-of-N; real Franka StackCup improves from 18/25 to 25/25 trials.

current_row.title: Res-HIL: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Zero-initialized TD3 residual on a 20-demo ACT. Human takeovers become regression targets plus penalties on the steps just before them. After 10 min: 100/64/50/66/92% vs HIL-SERL 90/30/10/0/0 and ResFiT 0/0/0/0/0.

current_row.title: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
current_row.short: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
current_row.one_line: CCPL: a Gaussian-process preference model shares feedback across nearby exoskeleton operating contexts; retrospective analyses of ankle/elbow data (nine adults) estimate ~37%/17% fewer exposures than independent learning for equal reconstruction accuracy; online benefit not yet shown.

current_row.title: RegenHarness: A Robot Agent Harness with Evidence-Gated Recursive Self-Improvement
current_row.one_line: Robot agent harness with isolated planning/supervision/verification/recovery contexts and a commit gate; evidence-gated self-improvement revises harness configuration from execution records without weight updates; quadruped warehouse demo.

current_row.title: BrickCraft-Duo: Efficient Dual-Arm Skill Learning and Refinement for Compositional Long-Horizon Assembly
current_row.one_line: Learns reusable dual-arm brick-assembly skills from demos, composes them with stability-aware reasoning, and refines them with human-in-the-loop correction; at least 95% step-level and at least 60% long-horizon success on five real tasks (up to nine steps).

current_row.title: Banana Kick: Response-Informed Skill Evolution for Humanoid Soccer
current_row.one_line: RISE ranks bounded objective changes by response sensitivity from cached rollouts and accepts only verified progress, evolving a G1 humanoid's ordinary kick into a curved one. Sim joint target attainment 50.9% vs 15.2% for a learning-progress curriculum; 30 hardware trials.

current_row.title: An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics
current_row.short: An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics
current_row.one_line: After pretraining, streaming deep RL adapts quadruped policies online to unforeseen changes, improving task success up to 90% over the pretrained policy and beating batch on-policy; manipulation only partially succeeds.

current_row.title: TANDEM: Task and Motion Planning with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Fine-tuning
current_row.one_line: TAMP with VLM-added predicates asks for teleoperation only on steps it cannot plan; on one task it collects 2.9x the demos of full teleop in equal human time; 20 demos/task lift pi0.5-DROID's average success 0% to 60% (five real tasks).

current_row.title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
current_row.short: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic…
current_row.one_line: Agent writes/integrates new manipulation skills over 123 improvement rounds; gains fail to compound due to relational perception limits, skill chains stuck on early steps, and flawed evaluators.

current_row.title: Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy
current_row.one_line: Contact-aware morphometric retargeting of human hand motion, RL refinement for dynamic feasibility, then visuomotor distillation; 89.3% zero-shot success over 300 real trials on 30 objects.

current_row.title: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
current_row.short: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
current_row.one_line: TD-MPC2-based world model from wrist-camera depth and proprioception, trained on up to 90 insertion tasks; in simulation, 56% zero-shot success on unseen part geometries vs 7% for a model-free baseline; finetuning on held-out parts is more data-efficient than from scratch.

current_row.title: CereVLA: Cerebellum-Inspired Consequence-Aware Residual Governance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Execution
current_row.one_line: Flow-based residual refinement on a frozen action-chunked VLA, gated by a recurrent consequence predictor that suppresses unfavorable corrections. Real SO-101 pick-and-place, 40 trials: success 57.5% → 90.0% vs frozen SmolVLA, 19.6% fewer control steps on successful trials.

current_row.title: BEE: Intervention-Adaptive Real-World Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Residual actor on a frozen pi0.5, constrained toward human corrections by a learned per-dimension Gaussian correction model (Mahalanobis constraint). Matched online-data budget, 3 real + 1 sim task: average success 91.2% vs RLT 57.5%, DSRL 42.1%, SFT base 38.8%.

current_row.title: Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy
current_row.one_line: Novelty/competence-gated exploration-noise controller for PPO fine-tuning of SmolVLA on LIBERO-10. No task collapses (pooled definition) in its 3 seeds, vs 2 of 3 seeds for fixed noise and every learned-noise seed run to iteration 200; no arm beats BC.

current_row.title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
current_row.one_line: Hill climbing with a frozen LLM: resamples programs conditioned on the best verified solution so far; beats repeated sampling and test-time ES, and sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods (not robotics).

current_row.title: Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
current_row.one_line: Training-free best-of-N: sample 8 text-to-motion candidates, simulate each under the pretrained SONIC tracker on Unitree G1, keep the best-executed; upright execution rises from 80.5% (first sample) to 89.5% on 4,184 HumanML3D test prompts.

current_row.title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
current_row.one_line: Closed-loop driving simulator built on a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model; under its new FDpi fidelity metric it beats the strongest prior closed-loop simulator 1.6x on nuScenes and 4.7x on NAVSIM; its Navhard-CL benchmark exposes missing recovery behaviors.

current_row.title: Know Your Body: A Harness for Direct and Self-Improving Robot Control with VLMs
current_row.one_line: KnowBody: frozen-VLM control harness with an explicit, revisable body model seeded from one trajectory and refined by interaction; 75% vs 25% completion for native harness on four real-robot tasks.

current_row.title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
current_row.one_line: GC-VLA predicts multiview geometry-change tokens, then adds Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow learned from closed-loop feedback; LIBERO success rises from 95.20% to 99.55%.

current_row.title: Imperfection for Precision: Upcycling Imperfect Data for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: ε4P co-trains a flow-matching VLA on imperfect data by noise level (low-precision target-task data at high noise, high-precision mismatched-task data at low noise); real robot: up to +31.7 points; replacing equal high-quality data costs 4.2 points on average.

current_row.title: DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation
current_row.one_line: Planner plus object-centric IK with a residual RL policy and implicit curriculum lifts sim demo-generation success 41.30% → 78.37%; DP3 policies trained on its data reach 30-60% on three real tasks vs 0-10% with DOMINO data.

current_row.title: SafeLoop: Risk-Aware Rollback for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Non-invasive wrapper predicts collision/object-failure risk from vision and proprioception, then checkpoints or rolls back and re-queries the frozen VLA; ~70% fewer hazards on 24 LIBERO and 3 real tasks.

current_row.title: HiRE: Hindsight Reward Editing for Policy Finetuning
current_row.one_line: Training-free reward: a vMF-kernel density log-ratio of foundation-model features (DINOv2, SigLIP) from success vs failure buffers, added via potential-based shaping; real bottle pick-and-place rises 20% to 67% (30 trials), while sparse and Robometer baselines nearly fail early in training.

current_row.title: RouteRLT: Learning When and Which RL Specialist Should Control a Vision-Language-Action Policy
current_row.one_line: A learned router decides when a per-phase RL specialist (RL-Token-style readout) takes over from a frozen SmolVLA. Full-task success on three LIBERO-Object tasks 85.00% → 92.22%; real cable insertion 6.7% → 35.0% (operator-aligned handoff).

current_row.title: Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate
current_row.short: Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate
current_row.one_line: GLIDE infers task failure modes as executable guardrails, refined from trajectory feedback, that filter teleop and policy commands; data-collection success 0-10% to 70-90%, guarded policies 60-70%.

current_row.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
current_row.one_line: Joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion world-model simulator with streaming rollouts, 24 FPS after optimization, and multi-embodiment/multi-camera support; code and weights released.

current_row.title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Hybrid PPO mixing offline motion-planner demos with online sim rollouts trains an optical-flow visuomotor pruning policy; 49.9%/46.0% sim success (apples/cherries), zero-shot transfer in 38 physical trials, and 7/15 vs 4/15 for point-cloud RRT-Connect in the lab.

current_row.title: GraspTune: Tactile-Driven Execution Refinement for Robust Grasping
current_row.one_line: Diffusion-pretrained residual policy, aligned with PPO, applies bounded tactile-driven TCP corrections during grasp execution. Sim stable-grasp success +9.55 to +20.70 pts across four proposal generators; real UR5e GraspNet 71.0% → 84.3% (600 trials each).

current_row.title: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting and Residual Policy Learning
current_row.short: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting…
current_row.one_line: Residual RL repairs human mocap in sim (MANO hand); contact-anchored retargeting plus a second residual policy adapt it to robot hands. Sim replay success 7.3% → 59.3% (single-hand), 16.0% → 62.4% (dual-hand); four hardware tasks use no real-robot training data.

current_row.title: InsertAnything: Generalizable Contact-Rich Precision Insertion from Simulation to Reality
current_row.one_line: Sim-only RL insertion policy using 3D fingertip force feedback and a decoupled gated reward; real insertion down to 0.02 mm nominal clearance, 20/20 on ManipulationNet peg-in-hole (Human-in-the-Loop protocol, autonomous insertion motions), and 95.0% (152/160) zero-shot on eight unseen real tasks.

current_row.title: Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering
current_row.short: Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering
current_row.one_line: Applies DSRL to social navigation: trains only the latent-noise policy over a frozen diffusion policy distilled from multi-seed RL policies, adapting to new social conventions; hardware-in-the-loop validated.

current_row.title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
current_row.one_line: Latent world model learning ordinal relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes via a permutation-equivariant operator; lifts VLA success on four RoboTwin tasks from 61.72% to 76.76% and a V-JEPA 2-AC planner's on two real tasks from 64.0% to 81.0%.

current_row.title: Beyond Visual Quality: A Study of Test-Time Planning with World Action Models
current_row.one_line: Studies picking among sampled actions by their imagined futures in world action models: an oracle pick raises same-state success from 68.9% (random pick) to 79.2%, but tested selectors leave much of that gain unrecovered; opportunity concentrates in few decisions.

current_row.title: Imagine-RL: Residual-Confidence-Guided Cross-Attention for World-Model-Augmented VLA Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: DSRL over a frozen pi0; its critic imagines 10-step visual/torque futures with confidence weighting. Four real tasks, 50 trials each, 100 RL trajectories including 50 warm-up: success improves 23.6% relative over DSRL and 60% relative over pi0.

current_row.title: ReVeal: A Reconstruction-Aware Real-to-Sim Framework for VLA Policy Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Scores phone-video reconstructions with view and planar-geometry fidelity metrics for VLA evaluation; the authors' depth-supervised PGSR-D vs 2DGS raises real-sim Pearson r 0.773 to 0.960 and cuts MAE 0.246 to 0.050 (GR00T, SmolVLA, pi0.5; 8 humanoid tasks).

current_row.title: Anatomy of a Closed-Loop Collapse: A Causal Case Study of a Compressed VLA Policy
current_row.one_line: An 8-layer Octo-Base distillation passes offline checks but scores 0/72 on simulated WidowX pick-and-place (teacher 40/72); replacing half the training stream with deployment-distribution teacher rollouts restores teacher parity (18/36 vs 17/36).

current_row.title: Verti-WM: A Physics-Aided Exteroceptive World Model for Off-Road Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Fuses a frozen Transformer (rigid terrain) with a neuro-symbolic terramechanics model (deformable) to replace simulator rollouts for off-road RL; PPO trains in 1.36 h vs 33.48 h in Chrono at similar success; real robot 4/5 vs 2/5 for direct sim-to-real.

current_row.title: Expert-Play Contouring Control: Faster-than-Demonstration Planning from Slow Expert and Fast Play
current_row.one_line: EPCC: extracts a time-independent progress contour from slow expert demos, trains a world model on fast play data, and plans to maximize contour progress; 2.0x the Diffusion Policy baseline's throughput, averaged over three simulated manipulation tasks.

current_row.title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: Starts world-model branches at states where the flow policy's 3-step and 5-step samples disagree. RoboTwin average 58.8 vs 54.3 for VLA-MBPO.

current_row.title: ForceRFT: Refining VLA Actions through Force-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning
current_row.org: EIT Ningbo; Jiangnan U; SJTU; HKUST-GZ; NUS
current_row.one_line: Force-aware TD3 residual bounded to 1 mm and 0.5 deg on a frozen force-conditioned SmolVLA, plus human corrections. Plug insertion: 12/30 prior → 25/30 within a 30-min budget.

current_row.title: FAN: Foresight Action Normalization for Continual Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Compares five action-normalization strategies for continual VLA adaptation; FAN freezes stats from a small task-independent calibration set, avoiding coordinate drift, best across four real single-arm/bimanual task streams.

current_row.title: Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-in-the-Loop Optimization
current_row.short: Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-in-the-Loop Optimization
current_row.one_line: Bootstraps a forward outcome model, uses it for active preference queries that learn a user-specific reward, then optimizes the assistive policy without extra trials; in simulation, an estimated 413 vs 563 queries (mutual information) to reach 10% preference error.

current_row.title: ProTracer: Proprioception-Guided Failure Diagnosis in Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Training-free VLM framework that turns proprioceptive robot-state signals into text to detect, categorize, explain and localize onset of manipulation failures; introduces FailTime benchmark.

current_row.title: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator Disturbance Compensation
current_row.short: Stability-aware Residual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robotic Manipulator…
current_row.org: Hanyang Univ.; Kyonggi Univ.; Kookmin Univ.
current_row.one_line: Residual RL over an NMPC + disturbance-observer loop, with a latent disturbance estimator and an ISS-derived action bound. Real 6-DOF arm, zero-shot, vs NMPC+DOB: tracking error −27.8% (circle), −16.7% (figure-eight); path RMSE −38.0% under unseen base vibration.

current_row.title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
current_row.one_line: Coda: frozen flow-matching VLA runs few-step sampling, then a lightweight Transformer predicts a demo-supervised endpoint residual; RoboTwin 50 tasks 71.64%→74.68% (5 steps); SmolVLA 2-step 60.8%→69.4%.

current_row.title: Sandwich-Residuals: Parameter-Efficient Test-time Adaptation of World Models
current_row.one_line: Freezes the latent world model and learns small residuals around the predictor from its own prediction error, no rewards; over 21 AdaJEPA-benchmark conditions, 1.3x frozen-model success, 95% of the best AdaJEPA variant, 97-99% fewer adapted parameters than AdaJEPA.

current_row.title: FRAMES: Failure Recovery And Monitoring of Embodied Skills for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Planner, VLM Monitor and Recovery agents supervise humanoid mid-level skills; monitor catches 48/50 failures and accepts 46/50 successes (94% accuracy) over 100 MuJoCo trials.

current_row.title: CommitFlow: Semantic Commitment Verification and Local Correction for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation VLA Execution
current_row.one_line: Closed-loop wrapper for a frozen VLA: a semantic commitment monitor holds back dependent actions until stage conditions hold, BoundaryFlow adds gain-calibrated local corrections; 75.9% mean success on ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, 22.7 points above pi0.5 (53.2%).

current_row.title: CARF: Contrastive Attraction-Repulsion of Failure-Guided Flow Matching
current_row.one_line: Progress-based scorer trained on successes labels imperfect-data segments; flow-matching policy is attracted to progressive segments and repelled from failure-critical ones, beating baselines in sim and real.

current_row.title: CounterPlay: Counterfactual Post-Training for Self-Play Driving Policies
current_row.one_line: Post-trains self-play driving policies by backtracking from failures via value estimates, retrying under reward-conditioned styles, keeping verified retries; BehaviorBench SOTA with 1B transitions (1% of anchor's 100B).

current_row.title: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
current_row.short: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
current_row.one_line: Replays simulated expert trajectories open-loop on a real Franka FR3 to record real observations, unifying data collection, closed-loop evaluation and sim-to-real gap measurement for chunk-based VLAs.

current_row.title: Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer
current_row.one_line: Embodiment-agnostic world model pretrained with optical flow, finetuned on target actions, steers a frozen base policy via latent-space search; with 50 target demos, relative gains of 16%/62% (Robomimic/real) for Diffusion Policy and 8%/14% for Pi0.5.

current_row.title: Scaling Vision-Language Reward Learning for Robot Manipulation in Parallel Simulation
current_row.one_line: RAPID: GPU-parallel IsaacLab rollouts plus single-request VLM preference labeling for reward learning; vs an RL-VLM-F baseline on five simulated Franka tasks, 8.0x end-to-end speedup, 95.5% fewer API calls, success 86.3% to 98.7%.

current_row.title: VLA-Scope: Shift-Aware Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Two-stage runtime monitor for OpenVLA: detects and classifies input shift, then logistic regression on shift category, action-prefix and progress features predicts failure; LIBERO-Spatial: 0.945 OOD ROC-AUC, 0.850 failure ROC-AUC after 60 actions (0.791 without progress).

current_row.title: VT-Bridge: Bridging Pretrained Foundation VLAs to VTLAs via Lightweight Residual Adaptation
current_row.one_line: 0.98M-parameter residual adapter fed estimated force/torque signals, on a LoRA-fine-tuned then frozen pi0, pi0.5 or SmolVLA; trained on up to 50 teleoperated demos per task (supervised, not RL). Four real contact-rich tasks: completion 11.7% (fine-tuned VLA) → 62.9%.

current_row.title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
current_row.one_line: Privileged-state scripted teacher with LLM-revised waypoints synthesizes demos; the VLA is SFT'd, then PPO-refined with binary reward. LIBERO-PRO, no new human demos: rescues all 27 zero-success tasks (direct PPO: 10); 97.8%/97.1% Position/Task-axis averages.

current_row.title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention (PARTS: Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks)
current_row.one_line: Masked, bounded TD3+BC residuals on human-identified bottleneck subtasks of a frozen pi0.5 SFT policy, gated by agent-written selectors and verifiers. Full task 50% → 95% (Franka) and 32% → 61% (YAM), with tens of minutes of real-world RL per task.

current_row.title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
current_row.short: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
current_row.one_line: Coding agent iteratively refines closed-loop robot policy code with simulation feedback (RoboCasa 28.3% to 64.2%); archived optimized code transfers to new tasks, +15.6 points over unoptimized references.

current_row.title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
current_row.short: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
current_row.one_line: SGPS: BC-initialized depth policies alternate sampling-based MPC action-target refinement with short-horizon first-order policy-gradient updates in differentiable simulation; learns simulated Go2/G1 skills, and Go2 specialists are distilled into one depth policy that transfers zero-shot to a real Go2.

current_row.title: StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation
current_row.one_line: A teacher VLM (Qwen3.5-397B) plus demos generates subtask-completion rationales, distilled by SFT into a 0.8B student VLM that decides stage transitions. Transition completion 96.23% (LIBERO), 90.18% (BEHAVIOR-1K); real arms 18/20 and 16/20 closed-loop trials, no real-robot baseline.

current_row.title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
current_row.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University et al.
current_row.one_line: World model aligned to DINOv2 target-centric servo error; reactive policy trained with imitation, consequence supervision and imagined rollouts favoring error contraction; real 7-DoF arm reaches 10% error region in 30/30 trials, retains it in 25/30 (26.67% without future-error alignment).

current_row.title: REFINEPPO: Learning Continuous Control Policies by Iterative Action Refinement
current_row.one_line: PPO whose actor builds each action by iterative residual refinement: a shared network repeatedly corrects an initial proposal given state and current action. Matches or exceeds PPO on 14 Gymnasium control tasks, converging faster on several.

current_row.title: Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation
current_row.one_line: RebarSim: privileged state-based RL teacher on procedural rebar geometries, DAgger-distilled into a multi-view RGB student; zero-shot 91.3% (137/150) real seating at 1.4 mm clearance; adapting to a new design takes 4-6x fewer distillation samples than training from scratch.

current_row.title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
current_row.short: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
current_row.one_line: Residual PPO adds bounded local corrections and release timing to a nominal task-space controller; 98.5% sim success over 512 conditions, real xArm7 26.7% to 63.3%.

current_row.title: Catch Me If You Can: Real-Time Feedback Denoising for Responsive VLAs
current_row.one_line: VLA-Feedback: low-frequency diffusion planning with the final denoising step kept as a high-frequency visual feedback interface; vs GR00T (same planner), dynamic sim tasks 27.5%→85.0%, real robot (3 tasks) 51%→73% (CoRL 2026).

current_row.title: Diverse and Adaptable Arm Coordination for Octopus-Crawling via Diffusion-Based Uncertainty-Aware Optimization
current_row.one_line: Diffusion-based optimization discovers and preserves diverse crawling coordination strategies for a simulated muscle-actuated soft multi-arm robot without demonstrations, adapting to new constraints without full retraining.

current_row.title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Contact-centric world model for deformable bag manipulation using larger time steps than its source simulator (10x faster state rollouts, excluding rendering); real bag lifting: 13/20 for a VLA fine-tuned on source-sim data alone vs 19/20 with WorldContact-expanded data.

current_row.title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model trained on 5h robot plus up to 100h human touch data; used as surrogate for policy evaluation and synthetic trajectory generation.

current_row.title: MAGMA-GEN: Validated Recovery Supervision from Ambiguous Failures via Counterfactual Re-Execution
current_row.one_line: Turns failed long-horizon manipulation rollouts into recovery supervision: a coach proposes corrections, kept only if re-execution from that point improves outcomes; beats distillation and trajectory repair (CoRL 2026).

current_row.title: EmbodiedMind: Adaptive Data Curation and Prefix-Tree Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Embodied Intelligence
current_row.one_line: RL post-training of an embodied VLM (Qwen3-VL-8B) that outputs text plans and answers, not motor actions: rejection-sampling SFT, difficulty-queued IR-GRPO, then Trie-GRPO with prefix-tree step-level advantages. 70.02% average over 18 multimodal, spatial and planning benchmarks.

current_row.title: OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher
current_row.one_line: RL-trained privileged teacher on vectorized inputs supervises closed-loop fine-tuning of camera driving policies in AlpaSim (3DGS); scene scores rise 1.6x (TransFuser) and 9.5x (VaVAM); in a separate vectorized WOMD study it matches RL fine-tuning with ~1000x fewer episodes.

current_row.title: GR2PO: Group Relative Return Policy Optimization for Continuous Robot Control
current_row.one_line: Critic-free GRPO-style RL for continuous control: discounted returns from parallel trajectories, group-normalized per time index, clipped updates. MuJoCo Ant/Walker2d/Humanoid: beats immediate-reward GRPO, near PPO/SAC (trails PPO on Humanoid); Jetson TX2 test is inference-only.

current_row.title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
current_row.one_line: LoRA-adapts a pretrained Robometer progress reward model with Plucker-ray camera conditioning and synchronized multi-view block attention; in sim, 41-69% lower progress error than averaging single-view RGB predictions; ~21% lower MAE on real tasks.

current_row.title: TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces
current_row.one_line: KDE scores from retrieved success and failure traces guide a frozen pi0.5, with no critic. Real ordered fruits TSR 21/50 → 39/50, then 47/50 after one more round.

current_row.title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
current_row.org: UT Austin, University of Florida, BrainCo
current_row.one_line: Single-image real-to-sim-to-real pipeline for dexterous hands (Gaussian background, VLM-inferred physics, VR teleop, trajectory synthesis); on six task pairs, 1:1 sim-real co-training lifts mean real success of ACT, DP and pi0.5 from 29.2% (sim-only) to 61.9%.

current_row.title: Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training
current_row.one_line: SFT, then human-gated DAgger, then a latent residual TD3 on a frozen pi0.5 for two 20-DoF hands. All 5 tasks reach 20/20. Transfer goes 10% → 65% → 70% → 100% with RL, using 3,000 online transitions per task.

current_row.title: HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface
current_row.one_line: Queries the current pi0.5 policy in shadow mode during handheld UMI demos; human-policy discrepancy triggers collection, then advantage-conditioned BC. Real Franka Stack Cube task-progress score (0-100, 10 trials) rises 84 to 100 over 3 rounds.

current_row.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
current_row.one_line: Identifies Value Flattening in PPO critics (flat predictions vs sharply varying Monte Carlo values); SP3O supervises only three well-separated states per response, improving LLM RL on Qwen3-Base.

current_row.title: ForceDelta-VLA: Distilling Force-Conditioned Action Corrections for Contact-Rich Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Distills force-conditioned corrections to a base VLA action; 82.2% versus 54.4% ForceVLA success over nine contact-rich tasks, with approximately 26% lower mean peak force over successful trials.

current_row.title: Not All Layers Need Tuning: Diagnosing and Directing Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: A diagnostic allocates variable-rank LoRA across VLA regions according to deployment shift; on a real xArm-7 instruction-wording shift, achieves 21/30 successes versus 22/30 for full fine-tuning, with 0.04% of its trainable parameters.

current_row.title: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
current_row.short: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Generates synthetic demos from reconstructed assets without teleoperated source trajectories, using constraint-guided mesh deformation that preserves contact geometry; zero-shot deployment on contact-rich long-horizon tasks, no real fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Studies when continual model-based RL should drop pre-shift replay: forgetting helps after large permanent dynamics shifts, hurts when dynamics recur; estimates staleness from interaction data across locomotion morphologies.

current_row.title: RAFAIL: Relationship-Aware Failure Detection for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Runtime failure detection via point-cloud anomaly detectors on task-relevant entity relationships, labeled offline by a VLM from successful demos only; 73.4% balanced accuracy on three real tasks.

current_row.title: Causal-History Test-Time Scaling for Failure Recovery in Autoregressive World-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Training-free failure recovery for autoregressive world-action models: progress-aware trigger detects stalls, rolls causal KV history back to a reliable prefix, then verifies three recovery hypotheses before committing.

current_row.title: FIERCE: From Generalist Robot Policies to Fast Specialists via Progress-Failure Feedback
current_row.one_line: A progress plus failure-risk evaluator shapes SAC for a distilled specialist; real mean 92.0% vs 83.0% with Robometer-guided RL after 300 rollouts (single seed).

current_row.title: DistAL: Distance-based Advantage Learning for VLA Fine-Tuning
current_row.one_line: Dense reward inside RECAP: negative kNN distance to the base VLA's training embeddings. Hardware mean 44.0 base / 60.0 binary reward / 69.5% DistAL.

current_row.title: XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience
current_row.one_line: XPACE shares a video backbone between a world-action policy and simulator. Heterogeneous human/robot training improves IRON robustness; fine-tuning on simulator-generated recovery trajectories further improves real-world task completion.

current_row.title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
current_row.one_line: A 33,985-parameter readout detects failures from frozen VLA-JEPA states: 85.68/88.59 pooled AUROC/AUPRC across seven tasks. Real-robot transfer varies and is tested with adaptation; 0.23ms timing covers only the readout.

current_row.title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
current_row.one_line: A world-model simulator uses a unified 28-dimensional action space. In RoboTwin simulation, adding 500 generated trajectories to 50 demos/task raises policy success from 70% to 93%; evaluation correlation is 0.994 across five checkpoints.

current_row.title: WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training
current_row.one_line: Shared transformer with world-model and action heads (mixed unidirectional attention mask); at deployment samples exploratory actions and test-time-trains the world model on collected transitions; CALVIN, LIBERO gains.

current_row.title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
current_row.one_line: World-action model caches predicted contact; a tactile expert corrects chunk actions during execution, 20.7x cheaper than regenerating; real success 22% to 64% across five tasks.

current_row.title: FailureSpot: Label-Efficient Timestamp-Level Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Timestamp-level VLA failure detection learns from weak labels on anomalous action chunks, then actively selects uncertain trajectories for annotation. Evaluated across VLAs with a fixed 15% timestamp-annotation budget.

current_row.title: World-Coherent Decoding: Self-Verifying Test-Time Planning for World Action Models
current_row.one_line: Samples futures from a frozen World Action Model, ranks video surprisal and action-path effort, and learns an execution-mismatch predictor. RoboTwin 2.0 Hard: 55.80% base WAM to 60.90% with limited randomized-scene supervision.

current_row.title: Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation
current_row.one_line: A wrench-predicting VLA uses contact-selective credit tags and bounded TD3+BC adaptation. Five real precision-assembly tasks: 16% alignment-only, 38% value-guided refinement, 82% full system; authors’ matched pi0.5+RECAP-style implementation scores 15%.

current_row.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
current_row.one_line: Cross-embodiment action-conditioned video world model: curriculum from latent actions on unlabeled video to end-effector/language actions; approaches or surpasses single-embodiment models on DROID, spans Bridge, YAM, G1.

current_row.title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
current_row.one_line: RA-VLA trains behavior-aligned demonstration retrieval and context-following execution on training tasks. It then adapts to held-out tasks through retrieved demonstrations without further weight updates; evaluated on LIBERO and a real UR5e.

current_row.title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency (ARLI: Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information)
current_row.one_line: DSRL under asynchronous VLA inference. It feeds the noise policy the committed actions plus a fresher mid-inference frame. Real success goes from around 40% to near 100% in 100-125 episodes.

current_row.title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
current_row.one_line: A frozen teacher relabels an accelerated WAM student’s own rollout histories. Preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, 12 paired evaluations/task: Flash-WAM improves Handover Mic from 0/12 to 7/12 and Put Object Cabinet from 2/12 to 4/12.

current_row.title: CIDER: Continual Interactive Distillation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: RLPD plus reverse-KL distillation preserves a frozen teacher’s skills. After six sequential real tasks, CIDER reports 100/100 successful trials per task (Wilson 95%: 96.3–100%); plain fine-tuning averages 16.7% over those tasks.

current_row.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
current_row.one_line: VLM-guided subgoals collect exploration trajectories, successful episodes fine-tune the VLA, and residual off-policy RL further optimizes it; evaluated on 22 simulated ALOHA manipulation tasks.

current_row.title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
current_row.one_line: Inverts demos into flow noise, keeps K=8 DCT modes, BC-initializes, then runs SAC on a frozen humanoid VLA. Toy Storage OOD with pi0.5: 2/10 → 8/10, while DSRL training failed.

current_row.title: τ0-VLA (tau0-VLA): a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
current_row.one_line: Confidence-gated beam search proposes subtasks, ranked with world-model and value predictions. Real Book Organization: 6/10 with the same hierarchy’s Plan Once baseline versus 9/10 with test-time search.

current_row.title: ViTaR: Visuo-Tactile Residual Adaptation for Foundation VLA Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Effect-Guided Modeling uses tactile feedback to select bounded residual corrections atop frozen OpenVLA-OFT. Seven simulated UniVTAC contact tasks: 61.3% mean success, 30.6 percentage points above the base.

current_row.title: Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.org: Peking University, EvoPhys AI and others
current_row.one_line: Adds rollout-history panels and OOD failure edits to the pairwise hop model; real repeated insertion 71/80 vs 48/80 for event-sparse reward.

current_row.title: PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation
current_row.one_line: A phase-aware distributional critic gives cleaner RECAP labels. LIBERO-Long 73.8 (ReCAP) → 83.3 (PACE).

current_row.title: FIRE-VLA: Failure-Informed Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
current_row.one_line: Low-reward, low-diversity groups trigger privileged-teacher self-distillation. Open-loop nuScenes, four-sample evaluation: mean L2 1.500m versus GRPO 1.848m (SFT 1.004m); single-sample improvement is inconclusive.

current_row.title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Two TD3 loops at different speeds for a VLA's semantic projection and action expert; CALVIN SR5 81.7 vs FLOWER 77.8.

current_row.title: ValueFormer: A Causal Transformer Value Function with Stage-Aware Labels for Semi-Autonomous Vision-Language-Action Policies
current_row.one_line: A 3.5M-parameter causal critic on DINOv3 for AWR reweighting and mistake detection; sandwich completion 70% to 85% (n=20, Fisher p=0.45, not significant).

current_row.title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
current_row.one_line: Action-conditioned world model with initial-environment guidance and visual history supports imitation-data generation and closed-loop policy evaluation. Reports the highest combined score across WorldArena Track 1 and both Track 2 applications.

current_row.title: Deployable Human Preference Alignment in Robotics: Learning Representative Rewards from Diverse Human Preferences
current_row.short: Deployable Human Preference Alignment in Robotics: Learning Representative Rewards from…
current_row.one_line: PREC clusters users into preference-coherent groups from binary preference labels and learns one reward model per cluster, beating a single shared policy in simulated locomotion.

current_row.title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.org: Renmin University; Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
current_row.one_line: A history-conditioned VLM value guides quality-conditioned pretraining and filters rollouts for residual adaptation. Real chip insertion improves from 46% to 86% over three rounds of 500 rollouts.

current_row.title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
current_row.one_line: Training-free plug-in for chunked VLAs: a latent-space vision monitor detects drift mid-chunk, truncates execution, and replans with online gradient guidance, giving an event-triggered adaptive action horizon.

current_row.title: FAR: Failure-Aware Retry for Test-Time Recovery and Continual Policy Improvement
current_row.one_line: Failure-Aware Retry uses a value function to locate problematic action chunks, applies preference-based policy updates between attempts, and adds lightweight action perturbations during retries to avoid repeating failures.

current_row.title: Trust Your Instincts: Confidence-Driven Test-Time RL for Vision-Language-Action Models (T^2VLA)
