current_row.one_line: GRPO uses DTW similarity to the policy’s most-confident rollouts as reward, without success labels. Simulated LIBERO: OpenVLA-OFT 91.0% to 97.2%; oracle-reward SimpleVLA-RL reference 99.1%.

current_row.title: Behavior Uncloning: Distilling Mode Redirection into Policy Weights without Inference-Time Steering (MoRE)
current_row.one_line: A temporary mode classifier guides policy-weight edits with a retain loss. Simulated Push-T desired-mode success averages 50.0% before versus 98.3% after MoRE; the original policy already completes the task in either mode.

current_row.title: Enabling Robust Cloth Manipulation via Inference-Time Simulator-in-the-Loop Refinement
current_row.one_line: Real-to-sim cloth mesh estimate plus MPPI in a GPU cloth simulator around the base plan. Real single-arm fold 3/10 → 9/10, dual-arm 1/10 → 8/10.

current_row.title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: SAC residual plus SpaceMouse interventions on frozen Diffusion Policy or pi0.5. Bases at 50-80% rise to over 90% within 40-90 min of real training.

current_row.title: PolicyTrim: Boosting Intrinsic Policy Efficiency of Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: PolicyTrim uses RL to improve action-chunk execution efficiency. For pi0.5 on LIBERO-Object, physical steps fall to 51.4% of baseline (48.6% fewer); the paper reports up to 5.83x end-to-end speedup.

current_row.title: Reversal Q-Learning
current_row.one_line: Offline RL for flow policies: treats each flow refinement step as an MDP action, using flow reversal for synthetic on-policy trajectories; no backprop through time; tops flow baselines on 50 simulated robot tasks.

current_row.title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Training-free runtime loop: feature probe for 3D object positions, kinematic failure state machine, and CBF action filter; lifts OpenVLA-OFT from 69.6% to 74.1% on LIBERO-plus.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Matching Policies with Density Transport
current_row.short: Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Matching Policies with Density Transport
current_row.one_line: RLDT fine-tunes flow policies toward an SVGD transport field from a maximum-entropy RL objective without backpropagation through time. Evaluated in simulation on Gym, state-based Furniture-Bench and vision-based Robomimic.

current_row.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Reward-free test-time latent-prompt tuning uses a state-grounding proxy loss. SimplerEnv WidowX: base pi0.5 51.1%, retrained latent-prompt policy 63.5%, then test-time tuning 67.4% (simulation).

current_row.title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies (LP-DS)
current_row.one_line: Learns residual noise perturbations for a frozen diffusion policy using a Lagrangian trust region to limit prior deviation. Walker2D return: approximately 5000 versus 4000 for the strongest compared baseline.

current_row.title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
current_row.one_line: Optimizes diffusion-world-model noise toward plausible VLM-specified failures. Failure recall rises 54% to 94%; using steered failures to downweight demonstrations raises real pi0.5 success from 39% with uniform-weight fine-tuning to 71%.

current_row.title: Bridging the Gap: Enabling Soft Actor Critic for High Performance Legged Locomotion
current_row.one_line: Policy initialization, timeout-aware critic targets and multi-step returns let SAC match PPO’s performance in parallel legged-locomotion simulation, with slower wall-clock training. Real-robot fine-tuning remains future work.

current_row.title: From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models
current_row.one_line: Demo2Reward optimizes a frozen VLM reward model’s prompt using 3–10 demonstrations to reduce false positives. Evaluated in simulated policy learning and one real Franka Panda Lid-On-Pot task, without extra model training.

current_row.title: PAPO-VLA: Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: Treats a VLA as planner plus executor: identifies planning actions via action variation and trajectory outcome, weights them by causal sufficiency/necessity, and injects weights into GRPO advantage estimation.

current_row.title: DyGRO-VLA: Cross-Task Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Grouped Residual Optimization
current_row.one_line: Learns shared multi-task VLA representations, then applies dynamically routed residual RL experts. Evaluated on LIBERO and RoboTwin2; sim-to-real tests on four tasks show mixed gains and limited real-world coverage.

current_row.title: OHP-RL: Online Human Preference as Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Uses human takeovers as pairwise preferences in SAC with a critic-based intervention gate. Real Franka Move Sand Bag success: 68% versus SILRI 66% and HIL-SERL 16%.

current_row.title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models (RAW-Dream)
current_row.one_line: A task-agnostic world model and zero-shot VLM rewards refine a policy initialized with one-shot SFT. LIBERO success: 43.4% to 52.3% without target-task world-model training; real Piper few-shot SFT: 50.0% to 71.7%.

current_row.title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking
current_row.one_line: Self-supervised action-ranking losses replace CQL-style pessimism; antmaze-large-play 91.2% vs Cal-QL 67.7%, plus pi0 VLA experiments in sim.

current_row.title: ProcVLM: Learning Procedure-Grounded Progress Rewards for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Procedure-grounded progress labels train a 2B reward VLM. Real stack-bowls soft success with SFT versus reward fine-tuning: 37.5%/62.5% at 5k steps, 70.8%/83.3% at 10k (12 rollouts per evaluation).

current_row.title: Sword: Style-Robust World Models as Simulators via Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping for VLA Policy Post-Training
current_row.one_line: Style augmentation plus latent scheduled sampling make the world-model simulator robust (Mixed FVD 111.19 vs 198.84 for WoVR). RL success is measured only inside the world model.

current_row.title: Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.short: Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: ME-AM adds mirror-descent entropy maximization and a mixture behavior prior to adjoint-matching flow-policy Q-learning, countering popularity bias; competitive or superior on sparse-reward continuous control.

current_row.title: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
current_row.one_line: Off-policy TD critics provide terminal rewards for group-sampled PPO over denoising chains, without GRPO’s variance normalization. On simulated Robomimic Square/Transport, DPPO takes about ten times longer to reach OGPO+’s final success.

current_row.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Robotic Manipulation via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning
current_row.one_line: LAPO jointly optimizes latent reasoning and actions with adaptive reasoning depth. LaST-R1 reports 99.9% average success on simulated LIBERO after one-shot warm-up and evaluates transfer across four real manipulation tasks.

current_row.title: WM-DAgger: Enabling Efficient Data Aggregation for Imitation Learning with World Models
current_row.one_line: Not RL: a world model synthesizes detour-and-recover data in place of human DAgger. Bag pushing reaches 93.3% with 5 demos vs 26.7% for BC.

current_row.title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Tri-state (+1/0/-1) relative-progress labels credit recovery; advantage-weighted BC folds towels at 99.4% vs 78.5% with SARM weights and 62.1% plain BC (trial count not reported; CVPR 2026 Workshops).

current_row.title: StageCraft: Execution Aware Mitigation of Distractor and Obstruction Failures in VLA Models
current_row.one_line: A training-free VLM rearranges clutter and obstructions before a frozen VLA executes. Across three real task domains with pi0.5 and SmolVLA, average success improves by 40 percentage points versus the obstructed workspaces.

current_row.title: Large Reward Models: Generalizable Online Robot Reward Generation with Vision-Language Models
current_row.one_line: Separately LoRA-tunes Qwen3-VL-8B reward models for contrastive progress, absolute progress or completion. After 30 PPO iterations on pi0.5 in ManiSkill3: 56.88% baseline to at most 60.93%, versus 66.87% with environment reward.

current_row.title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: DPPO on a humanoid diffusion planner, alternating with PPO on the low-level controller. Sim 50-70% → >90%. Booster T1 hardware 70% / 50% / 75%.

current_row.title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
current_row.one_line: Per-task consistency-model world model from about 6 h of play. Evaluation r 0.8455-0.9908 across checkpoints of DP/ACT/pi0/pi0.5; runs 10+ minutes at 15 FPS on a 4090.

current_row.title: AtomVLA: Scalable Post-Training for Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Latent World Models
current_row.one_line: Offline GRPO scores sampled action chunks using V-JEPA2 latent distances to subgoals and goals. LIBERO simulation average: 93.0% SFT to 97.0% after post-training without online environment rollouts.

current_row.title: SEAR: Sample Efficient Action Chunking Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: SEAR combines a multi-horizon causal critic with random receding-horizon replanning for off-policy action-chunk RL. Outperforms prior methods on the twenty hardest MetaWorld tasks; adding it to QC improves OGBench cube-triple offline-to-online learning.

current_row.title: PhysMem: Scaling Test-Time Memory for Embodied Physical Reasoning
current_row.one_line: A VLM planner tests physical hypotheses before reusing them as memory, without weight updates. Simulated medium-difficulty brick insertion: 76% success versus 61% free-form memory, 53% no memory and 23% direct experience retrieval.

current_row.title: LLMs Can Learn to Reason Via Off-Policy RL
current_row.short: LLMs Can Learn to Reason Via Off-Policy RL
current_row.one_line: OAPL: off-policy LLM post-training that embraces lagged inference policies (400+ gradient steps) instead of importance-sampling; beats GRPO+IS on competition math, matches DeepCoder with 3x fewer generations.

current_row.title: VGAS: Value-Guided Action-Chunk Selection for Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
current_row.one_line: A chunk critic with expected-max backup and geometric regularization reranks eight SmolVLA samples. Simulated LIBERO, five demos/task: 39.8% BC to 49.0%; plain Q-chunking scores 37.9%.

current_row.title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
current_row.one_line: GRPO trains a VLA inside WorldGym with GPT-4o rewards. Real eggplant-to-blue-sink success: 4% SFT to 72%; World-Gymnast outperforms RL trained in SIMPLER on three of four evaluated real tasks.

current_row.title: SA-VLA: Spatially-Aware Flow-Matching for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
current_row.org: Wuhan University; A*STAR IHPC; NUS; CAS; NTU
current_row.one_line: RL fine-tuning of flow-matching VLAs that preserves spatial grounding: spatial tokens fused with visual tokens, geometric progress dense rewards, SCAN spatially-conditioned exploration; better zero-shot spatial generalization on LIBERO/LIBERO-PLUS.

current_row.title: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
current_row.one_line: Video-model policy that is also a world model and value function. Best-of-N planning refit on 648 real rollouts raised hard ALOHA tasks from 59.5 to 72.0 average score. Mainly a policy architecture.

current_row.title: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
current_row.one_line: Pretrain BC to match a posterior over demonstrator actions so later RL can explore; Libero 16 tasks at 1000 rollouts best-of-N: BC 33.1, PostBC 55.1.

current_row.title: Scalable Offline Model-Based RL with Action Chunks (MAC)
current_row.short: Scalable Offline Model-Based RL with Action Chunks (MAC)
current_row.one_line: Action-chunk dynamics model predicts future state from an action sequence, reducing compounding error in model-based value expansion; rejection-samples a behavior policy; best offline MBRL on datasets up to 100M transitions.

current_row.title: RM-RL: Role-Model Reinforcement Learning for Precise Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Best-of-scene self-imitation plus REINFORCE for a discrete pick-pose correction. Shelf placement 10/10 for pretrained RM-RL vs 5/10 for plain REINFORCE. This is a cross-method comparison, and the pretrained variant uses about 200 extra prior samples.

current_row.title: Reflection-Based Task Adaptation for Self-Improving VLA (Reflective Self-Adaptation)
current_row.one_line: GPT-4o converts failure videos into dense rewards for OpenVLA PPO. Standard LIBERO average: 83.6% versus VLA-RL 81.0%; on separate LIBERO-Adapt ablations, removing success-filtered SFT collapses success to zero.

current_row.title: Refinery: Active Fine-tuning and Deployment-time Optimization for Contact-Rich Policies
current_row.org: USC; NVIDIA; University of Washington; University of Sydney
current_row.one_line: A GP over start states plus Bayesian optimization picks where PPO trains, and a GMM steers deployment. Per-step assembly success 83.61% → 96.35% in sim.

current_row.title: Verifier-free Test-Time Sampling for Vision-Language-Action Models (MG-Select: Masking Distribution Guided Selection)
current_row.one_line: Selects actions by KL divergence from masked-condition predictions. Jointly trained MG-Select* on pi0-FAST: RoboCasa’s eight pick-and-place tasks, 30 demos, 5.3% to 14.2%; SIMPLER average 46.9% to 50.3%.

current_row.title: Prosperity before Collapse: How Far Can Off-Policy RL Reach with Stale Data on LLMs?
current_row.one_line: M2PO constrains the second moment of importance weights for stable LLM RL on stale data. At staleness 256, clipped tokens average 0.06% versus GRPO’s 1.22%; experiments span six model scales.

current_row.title: Compose Your Policies! Improving Diffusion-based or Flow-based Robot Policies via Test-time Distribution-level Composition (GPC, General Policy Composition)
current_row.one_line: Convex mix of two policies' scores at each denoising step, with the weight grid-searched on rollouts. E.g. 86.39 vs 78.84 for the better parent on Robomimic+PushT.

current_row.title: SHaRe-RL: Structured, Interactive Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Industrial Assembly Tasks
current_row.one_line: Scripted manipulation primitives and human corrections let SAC learn only a 3D insertion primitive. On real industrial connectors, reported cycle time is 3.5s versus HIL-SERL’s 7.4s after about three hours of interaction.

current_row.title: Dual-Actor Fine-Tuning of VLA Models: A Talk-and-Tweak Human-in-the-Loop Approach
current_row.one_line: Human-in-the-loop BC+Q fine-tuning uses a second actor for language-guided latent corrections. Three real tasks: 25/25 successes each (Wilson 95%: 86.7–100%) versus HG-DAgger’s 25.3% average; whether evaluation includes human language corrections is unclear.

current_row.title: Balancing Signal and Variance: Adaptive Offline RL Post-Training for VLA Flow Models (ARFM: Adaptive Reinforced Flow Matching)
current_row.one_line: Critic-free softmax-advantage-weighted flow-matching loss with adaptive temperature on pi0. LIBERO simulation average: 88.1% base to 92.1%; flow RWR 90.8%, flow ReinboT 91.2%.

current_row.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: LLM RL algorithm replacing GRPO's token-level importance ratios with sequence-likelihood ratios and sequence-level clipping; more stable and efficient than GRPO, stabilizes MoE training, used for Qwen3.

current_row.title: RoboMonkey: Scaling Test-Time Sampling and Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
current_row.one_line: 7B VLM verifier trained on 20M synthetic preferences reranks Gaussian-perturbed OpenVLA samples. Real OOD 60% vs OpenVLA 35% and V-GPS 30%.

current_row.title: TGRPO: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action Model via Trajectory-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization
current_row.one_line: GRPO mixing step-level and trajectory-level group z-scores, with an LLM-written dense reward. LIBERO average 80.7 vs SFT 76.5 (v3), and not best on Goal.

current_row.title: Reinforcement Learning via Implicit Imitation Guidance (Data-Guided Noise, DGN)
current_row.one_line: Uses demos only to shape RLPD's exploration covariance, never as a BC loss; up to 2-3x improvement over prior methods on 7 sim tasks.

current_row.title: FastTD3: Simple, Fast, and Capable Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Control
current_row.one_line: TD3 with parallel simulation, large-batch updates and a distributional critic; solves a range of HumanoidBench tasks in under 3 hours on one A100 GPU.

current_row.title: ReinFlow: Fine-tuning Flow Matching Policy with Online Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: A learned noise network makes flow steps Gaussian for exact-likelihood PPO. Simulated image-based Can success: 57.83% to 98.50%; Transport: 30.17% to 88.67%. Reports 62.82% lower wall time than DPPO across tasks.

current_row.title: Interactive Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models (RIPT-VLA)
current_row.one_line: RLOO, PPO clipping and dynamic sampling use binary success rewards. LIBERO averages: QueST 82.7% to 93.6%, OpenVLA-OFT 96.7% to 97.5%. Best reported one-demo cross-scenario gain: 3.5% SFT to 97.2%.

current_row.title: ReWiND: Language-Guided Rewards Teach Robot Policies without New Demonstrations
current_row.one_line: A language-conditioned progress reward with rewind augmentation from about 5 demos per task; real bimanual policy 12% to 68% in 1 hour of RL.

current_row.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
current_row.one_line: Dr. GRPO removes a response-length optimization bias, improving token efficiency while maintaining reasoning performance. The paper’s complete minimalist R1-Zero recipe reaches 43.3% AIME 2024 accuracy with a 7B base model.

current_row.title: RoboCopilot: Human-in-the-loop Interactive Imitation Learning for Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: Compliant bilateral teleoperation system that lets a human seamlessly take over from and hand back to the policy, collecting interactive correction data for bimanual manipulation in sim and real.

current_row.title: ConRFT: A Reinforced Fine-tuning Method for VLA Models via Consistency Policy
current_row.one_line: Trains a consistency-policy head over frozen Octo using BC+Q: Cal-QL offline, then human-in-the-loop online fine-tuning. Across eight real-robot tasks, mean success rises from 39.4% to 96.3%.

current_row.title: Flow Q-Learning (FQL)
current_row.one_line: Pure-BC flow policy plus a one-step actor that climbs Q under a distillation leash; OGBench cube-double 29 vs ReBRAC 12.

current_row.title: Policy Agnostic RL: Offline RL and Online RL Fine-Tuning of Any Class and Backbone (PA-RL)
current_row.one_line: Samples policy actions, selects high-Q candidates, refines them by Q-gradient ascent, then distills with the policy’s own loss. PA-RL+Cal-QL on simulated CALVIN: 28% offline success to 61% after online fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Robot Learning with Super-Linear Scaling (CASHER)
current_row.one_line: Crowdsourced real-to-sim scans plus sim RL bootstrapped by human demos; the improving generalist policy replaces human effort, giving zero/few-shot real transfer and scan-only fine-tuning.

current_row.title: Inference-Time Policy Steering through Human Interactions (ITPS)
current_row.one_line: Human clicks, sketches or nudges define inference-time costs for steering pretrained generative policies. Compares sample ranking, gradient guidance and diffusion-specific stochastic sampling, studying intent alignment versus constraint satisfaction.

current_row.title: Coarse-to-fine Q-Network with Action Sequence for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Critic-only coarse-to-fine Q-network over action sequences; avoids actor-driven overestimation that breaks chunked SAC/TD3 (curves only).

current_row.title: Bidirectional Decoding: Improving Action Chunking via Guided Test-Time Sampling (BID)
current_row.one_line: Training-free selection among N chunks by coherence with the last chunk and contrast with a weak checkpoint. 32% average relative gain over vanilla closed loop on 7 sim tasks.

current_row.title: Representation Alignment from Human Feedback for Cross-Embodiment Reward Learning from Mixed-Quality Demonstrations
current_row.short: Representation Alignment from Human Feedback for Cross-Embodiment Reward Learning from…
current_row.one_line: Shows cross-embodiment IRL (e.g., XIRL) fails on mixed-quality demos; studies representation learning aligned with human feedback to improve transferable reward learning and shaping.

current_row.title: IRASim: A Fine-Grained World Model for Robot Manipulation
current_row.one_line: An action-conditioned video model ranks candidate chunks using predicted-outcome IoU. Push-T IoU: 0.637 to 0.961 with 50 candidates and 1,000 world-model training rollouts; without rollout training data, 50 candidates score 0.418.

current_row.title: Video-Language Critic: Transferable Reward Functions for Language-Conditioned Robotics
current_row.one_line: A CLIP-initialized video-text critic learns contrastive and temporal-ranking rewards. At matched hand-reward convergence budgets on MetaWorld: 58% sparse-only success, 78% with in-domain MW50 VLC, 65% with cross-embodiment Open X VLC.

current_row.title: IntervenGen: Interventional Data Generation for Robust and Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: Expands 10 human interventions into 1,000 synthetic corrections. In simulated Coffee with injected pose-estimation error and full observability on contact, success improves from 2% base to 80%.

current_row.title: Bayesian Optimization for Sample-Efficient Policy Improvement in Robotic Manipulation (BOpt-GMM)
current_row.one_line: Imitate from about 10 demos with a GMM dynamical system, then BO (SMAC3) on sparse binary success. In sim it reaches 80% success 87 episodes earlier than SAC-GMM.

current_row.title: Yell At Your Robot: Improving On-the-Fly from Language Corrections
current_row.one_line: High-level policy over language-conditioned low-level skills takes real-time verbal corrections and is iteratively retrained on them, improving long-horizon dexterous manipulation without extra teleoperation.

current_row.title: Offline Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Scales to Large Models (Perceiver-Actor-Critic, PAC)
current_row.one_line: Up to about 1B-parameter offline actor-critic with one BC-to-RL knob; self-improvement on real CHEF from 69.8% to 93.2%.

current_row.title: SERL: A Software Suite for Sample-Efficient Robotic Reinforcement Learning
current_row.org: UC Berkeley; University of Washington; Stanford; Intrinsic
current_row.one_line: Tuned real-robot RLPD stack with reward classifiers; 100/100 success on 3 tasks with 20-105 min of training.

current_row.title: RESPRECT: Speeding-up Multi-fingered Grasping with Residual Reinforcement Learning
current_row.one_line: Learns a residual policy on top of a DRL-pretrained multi-fingered grasping policy, reusing its components; about 5x fewer timesteps than from scratch, validated on the real iCub.

current_row.title: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Self-Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.short: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations with Self-Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
current_row.one_line: SSDF: self-supervised quality scoring of failed-trajectory segments using expert plus imperfect data; high-scoring segments augment offline BC training, improving success on ManiSkill2 and a real Franka, reward-free.

current_row.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning (IBRL)
current_row.one_line: Frozen BC policy and TD3 actor both propose; the critic picks, also inside the TD target. Real Hang task: BC 65%, RLPD 15%, IBRL 85%.

current_row.title: Model-Based Runtime Monitoring with Interactive Imitation Learning
current_row.short: Model-Based Runtime Monitoring with Interactive Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: A latent dynamics model and failure classifier predict problems and request human supervision before failure. Evaluated as a human-robot interactive-imitation system in simulation and on hardware; the human decides whether to intervene.

current_row.title: Robot Fine-Tuning Made Easy: Pre-Training Rewards and Policies for Autonomous Real-World Reinforcement Learning (RoboFuME)
current_row.one_line: A MiniGPT-4 success detector rewards reset-free Cal-QL fine-tuning. Across five real tasks, mean task score rises from 50.4% offline to 76.2% after 2–4 hours; the aggregate mixes success rates and candy-sweeping completion.

current_row.title: Q-Transformer: Scalable Offline Reinforcement Learning via Autoregressive Q-Functions
current_row.one_line: Per-dimension autoregressive Transformer Q-function trained offline on demos plus failures; 56% vs RT-1 25% on 72 real tasks.

current_row.title: Diagnosis, Feedback, Adaptation: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Test-Time Policy Adaptation
current_row.one_line: Counterfactual demonstrations let users flag task-irrelevant concepts. The flagged concepts drive data augmentation to adapt policies under distribution shift, which reduced fine-tuning demos in user studies (ICML 2023).

current_row.title: DreamerV3: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
current_row.one_line: Learns a world model and trains behavior by imagined futures. DreamerV3 combines normalization and robust value learning to use one configuration across more than 150 diverse tasks.

current_row.title: Graph Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Diverse Videos
current_row.short: Graph Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Diverse Videos
current_row.one_line: GraphIRL abstracts diverse (including human) videos into object-interaction graphs and temporally matches them to measure task progress as a reward; outperforms hand-crafted rewards on real-robot pushing.

current_row.title: Efficient Learning of Safe Driving Policy via Human-AI Copilot Optimization (HACO)
current_row.short: Efficient Learning of Safe Driving Policy via Human-AI Copilot Optimization (HACO)
current_row.one_line: Human-in-the-loop RL for driving: human takeovers during training yield proxy state-action values from partial demonstrations, giving safe, sample-efficient learning that beats RL and IL baselines.

current_row.title: EMaQ: Expected-Max Q-Learning Operator for Simple Yet Effective Offline and Online RL
current_row.one_line: Backup operator taking the max Q over N actions sampled from a behavior model, keeping the policy in the data's support with no explicit policy network. Matches or beats offline SOTA on D4RL and is competitive with SAC online.

current_row.title: Self-Supervised Policy Adaptation during Deployment
current_row.one_line: PAD: keeps updating the policy with a self-supervised objective at deployment, no reward needed; improves generalization in 31 of 36 environments, including real robot manipulation.

current_row.title: Learning from Interventions: Human-robot interaction as both explicit and implicit feedback
current_row.one_line: Expert Intervention Learning (EIL) uses both interventions and non-interventions as feedback on state quality and action optimality; learns collision avoidance from about one minute of expert control.

current_row.title: AWAC: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets
current_row.one_line: AWAC combines a TD critic with advantage-weighted actor regression for offline pretraining and online fine-tuning. Sparse simulated Adroit success after fine-tuning: door 95% at 800k steps, relocate 54% at 4M steps.

current_row.title: Scaling data-driven robotics with reward sketching and batch reinforcement learning
current_row.one_line: Human-drawn progress curves train a ranking-loss reward that relabels a 400+ hour robot log for offline distributional RL.

current_row.title: EnsembleDAgger: A Bayesian Approach to Safe Imitation Learning
current_row.one_line: DAgger extension using neural-network ensemble variance as a confidence measure to decide when the novice acts versus the expert; tested on inverted pendulum and MuJoCo HalfCheetah (IROS 2019).

current_row.title: Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning for Fast Quadrupedal Locomotion
current_row.one_line: Finite-difference hill climbing of a 12-parameter gait on 3 real Aibos: 291 +/- 3 mm/s after about 3 hours. A roughly hand-tuned start worked best.
